code: e = declare_sub_playlist(currentLine, pl_url, &attribs, sub_playlist, playlist, in_stream);
note: The HLS playlist line containing the input-controlled satip URL is accepted as a playlist element and passed forward for source loading.
The playlist element URL is used as a segment source URL and connected as a new source filter.
The segment URL retains the satip scheme, selecting SATIP initialization for the input-controlled string after RTSP parsing accepts the short host following the userinfo separator.
The SATIP server extraction loop is bounded only by the URL substring length and delimiters; it does not enforce the 1024-byte capacity of the local text buffer.
The long userinfo bytes before @ are copied as server-name characters until '/', overflowing the stack buffer text.
